messages.body: Intermediate is demanding but manageable. One paper at a time.
Work through a costing problem slowly and check each step.
Allow yourself time to understand, not just to memorise.
Solve costing and management problems every day. Practice is the method.
Work backwards from past questions to find what matters most.
Revise formulas weekly so they are ready when you need them.
You are well into the CMA journey. Look at what you already know.
Each paper you prepare is a mark of growth. Keep it up.
Your numbers are getting sharper every week. Be proud of that.
